micro_interview.question: A multithreaded C++ service gets slower when you increase worker threads from 4 to 16 even though CPU utilization rises. What hypotheses would you test first?
micro_interview.demonstrate: Measurement-first systems reasoning: lock contention, cache coherence/false sharing, memory bandwidth, context switching, task granularity and I/O; ability to design discriminating experiments.
micro_interview.practice: Rank five hypotheses, name one measurement or experiment for each, then give a 3-minute English answer. Do not jump directly to changing code.
